title: `accelerate launch` returns exit code `0` on error
author: salieri

comments.author: muellerzr
comments.body:
@salieri could you provide a little more information for me please? 

I need:

1. To know what GPU kind you are running on
2. To know what repo has `train_text_to_image.py` :) (e.g. is it diffusers?)

Thanks!

comments.author: SebastianEndrikat
comments.body:
A different example that should also exit non-zero:

```bash
Singularity> accelerate launch /not_a_file.py; echo "Exit code is: $?"
/anaconda/bin/python3.9: can't open file '/not_a_file.py': [Errno 2] No such file or directory
/anaconda/bin/python3.9: can't open file '/not_a_file.py': [Errno 2] No such file or directory
/anaconda/bin/python3.9: can't open file '/not_a_file.py': [Errno 2] No such file or directory
ERROR:torch.distributed.elastic.multiprocessing.api:failed (exitcode: 2) local_rank: 0 (pid: 223625) of binary: /anaconda/bin/python3.9
Exit code is: 0
```

```bash
cat /anaconda/lib/python3.9/site-packages/accelerate/__init__.py | grep version
__version__ = "0.14.0"
```

comments.author: salieri
comments.body:
@muellerzr Sorry, missed your question! I noticed that on A100s running [runpod/pytorch](https://hub.docker.com/r/runpod/pytorch) Docker image. But I believe I've seen it on my RTX4090/Windows setup too.

[train_text_to_image.py](https://github.com/huggingface/diffusers/blob/main/examples/text_to_image/train_text_to_image.py)

comments.author: psobot
comments.body:
+1 to this - it looks like [the code in launch.py does `except Exception`, then logs exceptions as they occur but does not propagate the exception upwards](https://github.com/huggingface/accelerate/blob/main/src/accelerate/commands/launch.py#L680-L689):

https://github.com/huggingface/accelerate/blob/b34db0b98743692993288979822f9eabe6098008/src/accelerate/commands/launch.py#L680-L689
